title: Measure GPU crossover and document the decision
description:
Benchmark the GPU prototype against CPU scalar and SIMD demappers and decide whether the modem GPU path should ship, remain experimental, or be deferred.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Benchmarks identify the batch-size crossover region versus CPU scalar and SIMD baselines.
- [ ] The outcome is documented clearly as ship, keep-experimental, or defer.
- [ ] The conclusion reflects measured data rather than speculation.

## Notes

This task closes the conditional GPU story with an evidence-based decision.
